description: Source code for a web scraper class 'AberleHome' that extracts recipe information from a website, including ingredients, title, author, category, times, description, instructions, ratings, yields, and nutrients.

classes.name: AberleHome
classes.description: A scraper class for 'aberlehome.com' extending 'AbstractScraper', with methods to extract recipe details.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Extracts ingredients list, falling back to HTML parsing if schema method returns empty.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Retrieves the recipe title, using schema or HTML fallback.

methods.name: author
methods.description: Retrieves the author, checking schema or meta tag.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Gets total cooking time, with exception handling.

methods.name: cook_time
methods.description: Gets cooking time, with exception handling.

methods.name: prep_time
methods.description: Gets preparation time, with exception handling.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Retrieves recipe description, with exception handling.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts cooking instructions, with multiple fallback methods.

methods.name: ratings
methods.description: Retrieves recipe ratings, with exception fallback.

methods.description: Retrieves total ratings count, with fallback.

methods.name: nutrients
